frame_counting_note: episode ale_frames is the actual ALE frame counter and includes the four-frame initial counter at reset under frameskip 4. The runner budget is enforced over post-reset action transitions: a 54,000-frame stop means exactly 13,500 env steps × 4 frames = 54,000 action frames; capped attempt records therefore show ale_frames=54,004 including the reset offset.
policy_selection_rule: lowest predeclared paired training seed 20261104; not selected by M6 or final evaluation result
